body_scope: All supplied RSS content:encoded HTML is preserved with original feed response status, bytes, hash, source URL and redirect history. Automatic prose extraction is separate from deliberate reading. Rendered media and parity with blocked article HTML are not independently verified.
routing_proof_scope: Exact RSS category slugs and official publisher sitemap tagged-page URLs, combined with the documented Medium publication tag feed schema. One explicit corporate writer feed is retained; no username is inferred from an author display name.

next_safe_action.prerequisite: The shared Medium rate limit must permit a coordinated recovery probe after a conservative cooldown and slower shared request budget. Do not retry blocked queries or switch domains around the circuit.

primary_sources.claim: Publication, custom domain, writer and tagged publication feed schemes are documented. Paywalled stories are not supplied as full RSS content.
The archived API is unsupported and documents publishing and authenticated identity resources rather than a supported public historical article reading endpoint.

gaps: Finite source frontier does not establish lifetime publication completeness.
Feeds can omit untagged or old posts beyond recent item limits.
Feed emitted content and individual article HTTP retrieval are counted separately.
RSS published timestamps can reflect Medium migration rather than original legacy publication.
Rendered media and blocked article page equivalence are unverified.
HTML archive and 2014 archive probes still return HTTP 403.
The shared Medium gate paused before Netflix recursive requests after three peer HTTP 429 responses. This is peer evidence, not a Netflix retry result.
The documented public feed frontier remains incomplete with 780 queued routes.
